parameter-group.name: Settings
parameter-group.label: Polling
parameter-group.description: Settings required to optimize the polling behaviour.

parameter.name: pollingPeriodPowerOffSeconds
parameter.label: Polling When Off
parameter.description: Seconds to wait to the next polling when device is off. Useful to save up i/o and cpu when your device is not working. If you use only this binding to control the device, you can put higher values here.

parameter.name: pollingPeriodPowerOnSeconds
parameter.label: Polling When On
parameter.description: Seconds to wait to the next polling for device state (dashboard channels)

parameter.name: pollingExtraInfoPeriodPowerOnSeconds
parameter.label: Polling Extra Info Period when On (0 disabled)
parameter.description: Seconds to wait to the next polling for Device's Extra Info (energy consumption, remaining filter, etc) when device is on

parameter.name: pollingExtraInfoPeriodPowerOffSeconds
parameter.label: Polling Extra Info Period when Off (0 disabled)
parameter.description: Seconds to wait to the next polling for Device's Extra Info (energy consumption, remaining filter, etc) when device is off

channel-group-type.label: More Info
channel-group-type.description: Show more information about the device.
